def: inspection (for relief); by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian "episcopate"
kjv: the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation

occurrences.text: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
